version.changelog: Add udp_log for message history review, udp_add_peer for hostname/IP peer addition, rolling hourly exchange limits, and real-time agent notifications for trusted peer messages

llm.summary: The skill implements a local LAN UDP messenger and its requested binaries/configuration match that purpose; nothing in the files or instructions indicates incoherent or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (local UDP messaging) align with the code and runtime requirements. The only required binary is node, and the plugin code implements discovery, send/receive, trust management, logging, and a hook — all relevant to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs installation via npm/GitHub and describes tools and a trust model. The runtime instructions and hooks are scoped to network messaging (discovery, inbox checks) and explicitly instruct not to auto-execute incoming messages. The plugin enumerates network interfaces and resolves hostnames (expected for discovery/hostname support) and binds a UDP socket on 0.0.0.0 — this is necessary for LAN messaging but means the agent will be discoverable on the network. Users should be careful on untrusted networks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry shows no install spec but SKILL.md and README describe installing the plugin from npm or GitHub; package.json points to a GitHub repo. These are standard install sources (npm/GitHub). No obscure URLs, download-from-IP, or extract-from-arbitrary-archive patterns were observed. Because code files are included in the bundle, there is no unexpected remote fetch required to run the provided implementation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or secrets and only needs the node binary and network access. The use of DNS resolution and reading network interfaces is proportionate to hostname support and broadcast discovery.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not modify other plugins. It binds a UDP socket and registers tools that can be invoked autonomously by the agent (the platform default). This is expected for a messaging plugin, but it does create a persistent network listener while enabled — review whether you want this enabled on the current host/network.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This plugin appears to be what it says: a local LAN UDP messenger implemented in Node. Before installing: (1) only enable on trusted/isolated networks (or use trustMode=always-confirm) because the plugin listens on 0.0.0.0 and will be discoverable; (2) do not auto-approve peers — follow the SKILL.md rules and review incoming messages before approving; (3) if you need stronger isolation, run the plugin in a sandboxed environment or restrict the port via firewall; (4) if you plan to install from npm/GitHub, review the repository (https://github.com/turfptax/openclaw-udp-messenger) for any changes; (5) avoid sending secrets or project data over this channel unless explicitly authorized by a human. Overall the package is coherent with its stated purpose.
